dateMeaning: Annual composite; WMS time is an index, not a single observation date
sourceResolution: NASA 2016 product: 500m nominal; WMS geographic sampling 1/240 degree
units: Display values 0-255, NOT calibrated physical radiance
alphaMeaning: Opaque display on black. Transparent light opacity was composited by WMS, never used as geographic coverage
processing: Original WMS PNG bytes; no local sharpening, upscaling or fabricated roads
credit: NASA Earth Observatory / NASA EOSDIS GIBS / Suomi NPP VIIRS
